name: agentheim-bridge
description: Local 127.0.0.1 bridge that lets the Agentheim dashboard open a real, interactive Claude terminal inside VS Code (ADR-0018). Loopback-only + per-activation shared-secret token; opt-in, off-by-default permission-bypass on POST /run via strict-true skipPermissions; sessions carry a derived/explicit display name via -n so the terminal tab and /resume picker entry stop reading "Claude"; sessions may also carry an allowlisted --model via POST /run's optional model field.
